name: VitaSTSlope
title: VITA ST Segment Slope at Peak Exercise
publisher: VITA Project Team, CS6440 (Georgia Tech OMS)
description: Categorical values for the ST segment slope at peak exercise, matching the Up / Flat / Down values of the Kaggle Heart Failure Prediction Dataset.

concept.definition: ST segment slopes upward from the J point.
ST segment is horizontal (no significant slope) after the J point.
ST segment slopes downward from the J point.
